scope: First run of the complete chain in one session: photographed document → capture gate → OCR/MRZ → document portrait → consented selfie → native YuNet/SFace templates → 1:1 comparison
database: PostgreSQL 18.6, API as restricted kyc_app (NOBYPASSRLS) after bootstrap
fixtures: Synthetic SPECIMEN documents with OpenCV public sample faces (lena.jpg, messi5.jpg) pasted into the portrait area; images not committed
policy: SFACE-COSINE-UNCALIBRATED-2026.10.1 (pass 0.363 / fail 0.20, uncalibrated → every comparison stays REVIEW)
observations: Same-person scores (0.69-0.84) and the different-person score (0.22) are clearly separated on these two samples; two identities are not a calibration set.
With the uncalibrated policy a different person also proceeds to LIVENESS_REQUIRED with face_match REVIEW; the risk engine (Phase 13) must not pass such sessions.
Templates are AES-GCM ciphertext (about 2.9 KB each); no template or similarity percentage is returned as identity proof.
